card.architecture: Qwen-Image 2.1 unified 7B single-stream DiT editor (Qwen3-VL 8B, native RGBA VAE, prefix KV cache)
card.summary: The same Qwen-Image 2.1 checkpoint edits an image with up to nine additional references, preserves people/products, supports local visual annotations, and can create or edit transparent layers.
use_cases: transparent layer editing and subject extraction
circle, paint, or mask-like visual guidance
card.commercial_use: no (Qwen Research License; separate commercial license required)
card.pick_when: You need the newest Qwen editor, several references, strong identity preservation, or alpha-aware editing.

prompt.guidance: Give a direct edit instruction and refer to the source and attachments as <image1>, <image2>, and so on.
prompt.example: Keep the person and pose in <image1> unchanged. Put the blue jacket from <image2> on them, preserve their face and the original lighting.
prompt.overview: Image 1 is the edit target; up to nine attachments become images 2-10. The visual encoder and RGBA VAE jointly condition the edit.
prompt.instructions: State what must stay unchanged, then the requested change. Refer to each input explicitly as <image1> through <image10>. Image 1 is always the edit target. The rest are references. For transparency, request RGBA/transparent output and save PNG. Default sampling is CFG 1, Euler/simple, 25 steps; 40-50 may improve quality.
do: Say what to preserve before what to change
Use extra images for identity, products, clothing, or style
dont: Attach more than nine extra references
Use vague references such as 'that image' in multi-image edits
Expect a negative prompt to act at CFG 1
prompt.negative_guidance: Unused at the official CFG 1 default.

speed.note: Prefix KV caching avoids recomputing reference context each step; many references increase cache memory.

ui_help.note: Upload the picture to edit, then optional references. Call them <image1>, <image2>, etc. in the instruction.
ui_help.good_for: identity-safe edits, multi-reference composition, and transparent assets

edit_use_cases: unified instruction editing with identity/product preservation, up to ten total images, and native transparency

reference.hint: The source is <image1>; attachments are <image2> through <image10>. Name them explicitly in the instruction.
